gender_stem_labor.name: Gender & STEM/Labor
gender_stem_labor.description: Examines stereotypical gender role assignments across technical STEM professions versus caretaking, clerical, or subordinate labor roles.
target_stereotypes: Female association with care work and support roles

socioeconomic_caste.name: Socioeconomic & Caste Nuance
socioeconomic_caste.description: Evaluates systemic bias mapping marginalized socioeconomic backgrounds and caste markers to sanitation, manual scavenging, and precarious labor versus academic, administrative, and white-collar prestige.
target_stereotypes: Marginalized communities associated with menial/sanitation labor
Privileged classes assumed default in academic and executive positions

regional_linguistic.name: Regional & Linguistic Stereotypes
regional_linguistic.description: Audits ethnocultural biases and regional prejudice between North and South Indian communities, linguistic chauvinism, and stereotyped occupational/cultural roles.
target_stereotypes: Monolithic regional caricatures and cultural reductionism
Language prestige hierarchy between Indo-Aryan and Dravidian linguistic identities
